reference: Olkiluoto, Finland, crystalline bedrock (no published log for these boxes)

description.lithology: Banded to veined gneiss (felsic gneiss/migmatitic tonalitic-granitic gneiss) throughout all three tray rows. Light grey to whitish-grey leucocratic quartz-feldspar dominated domains alternating with medium to dark grey biotite-rich melanosome bands/laminae. Medium-grained, well-foliated gneissic banded fabric with compositional layering, locally folded/ptygmatic and irregularly veined, leucosome appears coarser than melanocratic bands.
description.alteration: none visible - fresh grey tones, no visible chloritic, sericitic, silicified, potassic, carbonate or oxidised staining
description.mineralization: none visible - no identifiable pyrite, chalcopyrite, pyrrhotite, sphalerite or galena; dark material is biotite/amphibole fabric, not sulfides
